findings.reason: §8 must add graph/client.py:_slurm_service_uri to the delegating set and to its done-when, or the drift the section removes persists in the graph client's own SLURM step.
findings.text: `_slurm_service_uri` (called from `_resolve_graph_uri` at client.py:147) calls `discover_compute_node_local` at client.py:116 and re-implements the same squeue→`_resolve_compute_host`→localhost/direct-host resolution that §8 exists to remove, yet §8 names only profiles.py as the graph-client copy and its done-when requires only `profiles.py`, `get_embed_host` and `readiness.py` to delegate — landing §8 as written leaves this fifth independent discovery in place.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §8 concentrates four (in fact five, see below) SLURM discovery paths behind one owner, resolve_service_url, and §9 concentrates the DataAccess node write beside the edge merge in ingest_discovered_signals; no new module spreads complexity across shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §8 enumerates "four copies" of the SLURM service discovery and unifies three named files plus a rewrite, but imas_codex/graph/client.py:_slurm_service_uri is a fifth, live copy it does not name.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — this week's supplied figures are public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the adding sections account for themselves in their own text — §2 names the prototype keyword parking its three typed slots retire, §3 states why fronts_database retires nothing (no existing WikiPage property records the database a rendered page fronts), §8 states it adds no public definition and removes two private copies plus one rewrite, and §9 adds no interface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanisms it extends for every new move: enumerate_edas.py/check_edas.py (§2), the existing WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal linkage written by link_chunks_to_entities and already followed by the MCP tools at imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:547 and :818 (§3), the existing `deferred` document state (marked by mark_document_deferred, pipeline.py:1694) (§4), resolve_service_url as the discovery owner (§8), and the existing DataAccess writers (§9).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each proposed layer extends an existing mechanism rather than wrapping it (the linker gains one key in link_chunks_to_entities, tools-status reuses probe_remote_environment once, parallel.py consolidates to one DataAccess write), and §8 keeps only the remote auto-tunnel branch in profiles.py that the owner does not carry.
